facts.value: Projects are one of a kind of projects with clear, quantifiable goals to meet within a defined time frame in line with an organization’s strategic priorities.
The project scope outlines the work required to complete the project and clearly identifies what is included and excluded. Proper scope definition helps prevent misunderstandings and scope creep.
Unlike ongoing operational tasks, projects have a clear beginning and end indicating their temporary nature.
Projects require cross-functional collaboration and communication between stakeholders for success.
Projects need to be managed effectively in terms of money, time, people, technology, and resources within defined parameters.
